note: High-water frontier of every ID series, cached so a session can read it once instead of re-deriving it by grep. THIS FILE IS NOT AUTHORITY. CD-154 still requires next-free to be re-verified against a freshly fetched origin immediately before the commit that files a row, and TOOLS-CR-005 still requires it by both methods. tools/audits/state_check.py asserts every number here against the ledger's own rows, so a stale value cannot be pushed. Values are RAW STRINGS with zero-padding intact and are never int()-ed (CD-088(d)(i)).
provenance_note: `authored_against` is the PARENT commit this file was written against, not the commit it lands in — a file cannot carry its own SHA. The `high_water` values describe the tree AS COMMITTED, which includes rows added in the same commit. That is why the SHA is provenance and not authority: state_check.py re-derives every value from the ledgers on every run, so the field being stale can never make a number wrong.
